query.text: 请帮我照看孩子，有危险或需要帮助时及时通知我，并提醒我查看和安抚孩子。
query.text_en: Please watch the child, notify me promptly of danger or a need for help, and remind me to check on and comfort the child.

annotation.text_zh: 宝宝摔倒了，请及时查看并安抚。
annotation.text_en: The baby has fallen. Please check on and comfort the baby promptly.

annotation.text_zh: 宝宝开始哭了，请过去看看并安抚。
annotation.text_en: The baby has started crying. Please go check on and comfort the baby.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
